Name: Saph's New Introductions
Author: sapphicsaph
Description:
Saph's New Introductions rewrites those very familiar lines of introduction dialogue from the townies, in a vanilla-friendly way!

After playing this game over and over again, I thought of some new dialogue lines for each NPC for the first time you interact with them! That's all this mod does, without editing anything else! That's for later.

Note to translators: feel free to either send me a translated file for me to pop into the main mod, or post it as a separate mod!
